Records only – the Sumerian city laments and the Curse of Agade (not obtained)

Checked 2026-10-19 for the city-lament corpus (קינות-על-ערים/). Nothing below was downloaded.

Item Status
N. Samet, The Lamentation over the Destruction of Ur (Mesopotamian Civilizations 18; Winona Lake: Eisenbrauns 2014) – the current critical edition (composite, score, translation, commentary; from her Hebrew University dissertation) Paid (Eisenbrauns / Penn State UP; Project MUSE lists it as not open access; JAOS review by lockwoodonlinejournals). A Payhip listing of unclear authorization was ignored. Its numbering = Kramer 1940 = ETCSL.
J. S. Cooper, The Curse of Agade (Johns Hopkins Near Eastern Studies; Baltimore 1983) – the standard edition (composite, score, translation, commentary; the Ur III version) archive.org curseofagade0000unse: lending only (access-restricted, print-disabled) – recorded, not worked around (guidelines §2.3).
P. Michalowski, The Lamentation over the Destruction of Sumer and Ur (1989) archive.org bwb_O9-AQQ-497: print-disabled lending only. Needed for project 3 of the corpus, if it is undertaken.
Th. Jacobsen, The Harps that Once… (Yale 1987), pp. 359–374 (Agade), 447–477 (Ur) Paid.
J. Klein, "Lamentation over the Destruction of Sumer and Ur" / partial Lament for Ur, in The Context of Scripture I (1997) Paid.
P. Attinger, "Remarques à propos de la 'Malédiction d'Accad'", RA 78 (1984) 99–121 Paywalled (JSTOR / Cairn).
F. W. Dobbs-Allsopp, Weep, O Daughter of Zion: A Study of the City-Lament Genre in the Hebrew Bible (BibOr 44; Rome 1993) Paid (GBPress). The standard comparison of the Mesopotamian city laments with Lamentations.
U. Gabbay, Pacifying the Hearts of the Gods: Sumerian Emesal Prayers of the First Millennium BC (HES 1; 2014) Paid (Harrassowitz). On the balaĝ / eršemma genres and the gala priest.
P. Delnero, How To Do Things With Tears: Ritual Lamenting in Ancient Mesopotamia (SANER 26; 2020) Not found as open access (2026-10-19).
Hebrew: J. Klein and S. Shifra, בימים הרחוקים ההם (Am Oved 1996) In copyright; not owned. Rank 6.

What we use instead: ETCSL 2.2.2 and 2.1.5 (base texts, ETCSL's English as rank 3), ORACC Q000379 / Q000375 (lemmas, morph), Kramer 1940 (open, rank 5).
